# netbox_service_templates (Data Source)

Retrieves all service templates from NetBox. Narrow the result with filter blocks and cap it with limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_service_templates" "example" {
  filter {
    name  = "name"
    value = "example"
  }
  limit = 10
}

output "service_templates_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_service_templates.example.service_templates[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (Block Set) Filters that select which items are returned. Each filter is a name/value pair. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of items to return. Defaults to 0, which returns all items.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `service_templates` (Attributes List) The service templates found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_templates))

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the field to filter by.
- `value` (String) The value of the field to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--service_templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `service_templates`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the service templates.
- `created` (String) The created of the service templates.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the service templates, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the service templates.
- `id` (Number) The id of the service templates.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the service templates.
- `name` (String) The name of the service templates.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the service templates.
- `port_mappings` (List of String) The port mappings of the service templates.
- `ports` (List of Number) The ports of the service templates.
- `protocol` (String) The protocol of the service templates.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
